description: These rules automatically swap values when deploying between stages.

data_source_rules.description: Swap the Lakehouse destination from Dev to UAT
data_source_rules.how: In pipeline UI → Gear icon on UAT stage → Deployment rules → Data source rules

parameter_rules.how: In pipeline UI → Gear icon → Deployment rules → Parameter rules

parameter_rules.why: UAT only tests with EMEA data to keep refreshes fast
Same table name in UAT — no override needed, but shown for completeness

data_source_rules.description: Swap the Lakehouse destination from UAT to Prod

parameter_rules.why: Prod needs ALL regions — full dataset

what_happens_when_you_deploy.step_2: The pipeline copies the Dataflow Gen2 definition to the UAT workspace
what_happens_when_you_deploy.step_3: Data source rules automatically swap Dev_Lakehouse → UAT_Lakehouse
what_happens_when_you_deploy.step_4: Parameter rules automatically set pLakehouseName='UAT_Lakehouse', pFilterRegion='EMEA'
what_happens_when_you_deploy.step_5: The dataflow in UAT now points to the correct UAT resources — no manual edits!
what_happens_when_you_deploy.step_6: You trigger a refresh in UAT to load data, then validate with business users
what_happens_when_you_deploy.step_7: When approved, deploy UAT → Prod (same process, Prod rules kick in)
